question: After conformalising stored Chronos-2 quantiles (no re-forecasting), is PI80 calibrated in each diurnal-amplitude regime, at an interval score not worse than ridge + aci_amp?
prior_exposure: T2 NOTES.md reported lockbox PI80 mean width at 60 min (raw q10-q90, T1 0.50, T2 0.63) as a post-hoc remark. No coverage of any Chronos-2 quantile was computed in T1-T3.
The NB1 lockbox 10-24/10 was already opened for point forecasts (H1.4, H1.9, T1, T2).
aci_amp (24 h window, range) was chosen in RL-19 after seeing an earlier lockbox; nothing is re-tuned here.

h3.chosen_definition: PI80 of Chronos-2 + aci_amp has coverage in [0.75, 0.85] AND frac_infinite <= 0.01 AND mean Winkler <= 1.05 x ridge + aci_amp (same rows, finite on both sides), in every horizon x regime cell.
h3.source_conflict: HANDOFF-paper1.md: coverage only, both regimes. Plan 5.1: coverage in both regimes + Winkler not worse than ridge + aci_amp by more than 5 %.
h3.why_this_definition: The plan's definition strictly contains the handoff's. Coverage alone can be bought with wider intervals, and the paper's question is whether Chronos-2 intervals are useful against the strong baseline; Winkler penalises exactly that. frac_infinite <= 0.01 is the H1.3 / RL-19 gate. The handoff reading stays visible: h3a (coverage + frac_infinite only) is reported separately for each dataset.
h3.decision_is_on_point_estimates: as the H1.3 / RL-19 gate; day-block bootstrap CIs are descriptive

verdict_rule.nb1: 'fail' if any large-regime cell fails, otherwise 'not_fully_testable_large_only_pass'. NB1 can never give a plain pass, see nb1_regime_check.
verdict_rule.cdmo: 'pass' only if all 3 reserves pass in all horizon x regime cells (36 cells), otherwise 'fail'. Cells under min_cell_rows count as not passed.
verdict_rule.overall: 'rejected' if NB1 or CDMO fails; otherwise 'partially_supported' (never 'supported', because the NB1 small regime is untested).

nb1_regime_check.regimes_as_defined: small = before 2026-08-15, large = after 2026-08-20 (plan 5.1; RL-57 amplitude 0.5-1.2 vs 3.7-4.05 C)
nb1_regime_check.conclusion: T1 has zero origins in the small regime, and even by amplitude never reaches 0.5-1.2 C. The stored forecasts cannot test the small regime, and re-forecasting is out of scope. H3 is therefore NOT fully testable on NB1: only the large regime is tested. The definition is not changed to hide this.
nb1_regime_check.descriptive_only_not_h3: lockbox rows split at the lockbox median of A(t); scenario S1 (below).

cdmo_regime.definition: per station, trailing 24 h range A(t) at issue time (min 48 of 96 values) vs the station median of A over train 2024-02-01 to 2025-01-31 sampled daily at 00:00 LST: small = A < median, large = A >= median
cdmo_regime.series: station Temp from T3 data-cdmo/<station>.parquet, values with time_lst <= issued_at
cdmo_regime.why: CDMO has no calendar break like NB1; a state-based split fixed on pre-test data uses no outcome and no test information. Train medians 1.10-2.50 C.
cdmo_regime.caveat: A modest split (q10-q90 about x1.5-3 within station, seasonal and tidal), not the suspected x5 sensor regime change of NB1. A CDMO pass does not transfer to the NB1 claim.

sites.rule: reserve = first 3 letters of station code: rkb (4 stations), gtm (3), mar (1). Inference unit is the reserve (rows pooled within it); the station table is descriptive. 8 stations are not 8 independent observations.

methods.cqr_static: CQR score s = max(q10 - y, y - q90); [q10 - Q, q90 + Q]; Q = finite-sample conformal quantile of calibration scores
methods.cqr_aci: same score, ACI with delayed feedback (forecast_conformal.aci_intervals), pool seeded with calibration scores
methods.cqr_aci_amp: PRIMARY. s / max(A, floor), ACI with delayed feedback, Q = q_norm x max(A_now, floor), by core.forecast_intervals.aci_amp_half_width
methods.cqr_aci_amp_literal: sensitivity: as cqr_aci_amp with the literal RL-19 gamma
methods.sym_aci_amp: sensitivity: |y - q50| with aci_amp, ignoring stored quantile spread
methods.ridge_static / ridge_aci / ridge_aci_amp: |y - prediction| score, same calibration rows, amplitude, floor and gamma rule
methods.crossed_interval: Q < -(q90-q10)/2 gives L > U: collapsed to the midpoint, width 0
methods.missing_amplitude: core rule: infinite interval, counted in frac_infinite, never a guessed scale. Calibration rows without amplitude are dropped.

gamma.primary: gamma = 0.075 / lag, lag = max(1, ceil(h / stride)) origins. stride 15 min on NB1, 360 min on CDMO.
gamma.why: RL-19 gamma = 0.005 x 15 / h was derived for one origin per minute, where feedback lags h origins and the step per feedback lag is 0.075. This generalisation keeps 0.075 per lag and equals RL-19 exactly at stride 1. The literal formula on stride 15 / 360 would be 15-360 times less adaptive and close to static at long horizons.
gamma.sensitivity: literal RL-19 gamma = 0.005 x 15 / h, reported on both datasets, not used in the verdict

amplitude.floor: 0.25 x median calibration amplitude, per station, shared by Chronos-2 and ridge
amplitude.nb1_series: persistence prediction (lag_1m) of B5D at horizon 15, indexed by issued_at, min_count 720

causality.known_at: NB1: max(valid_at, actual_at) from the bench row (join asserted, actual must match). CDMO: issued_at + h on the 15-min grid.
causality.join_check: T1 small and bench B5D have 0 duplicate (issued_at, horizon) rows and 26345/26345 matched keys (checked on keys only).
causality.rule: origin s feeds the pool and alpha only when known_at_s <= issued_at_t; tested on synthetic frames

calibration.nb1_primary: last 3 rolling folds with forecast_conformal.calibration_residuals (drop known_at >= first lockbox issued_at); evaluate the lockbox
calibration.cdmo_primary: rows with known_at < 2025-05-01; evaluate issued_at >= 2025-05-01 (T3 forecasts start 2025-02-01, so about 3 months, n about 258-356 per station x horizon). Rows in between are dropped and counted. No test row is used in calibration.
calibration.scenario_S1_descriptive: NB1 only: calibrate on folds 1-2 (A about 2-3 C), evaluate folds 3-5 (A up to 6 C), lockbox untouched. Not H3.

reports.metrics: coverage, frac_infinite, mean and median width, mean Winkler on finite rows, by horizon x regime x group
reports.groups: NB1: one site. CDMO: reserve (decision), equal-weight mean of reserves, station (descriptive).
reports.daily: NB1 local date, min 60 rows. CDMO LST date by reserve, min 4 rows, and ISO week, min 20 rows. Worst period is reported.
reports.ci: 95 % day-block bootstrap, 1000 draws, seed 0, descriptive, ignores between-site dependence
reports.not_run: NCEI 0052765, because the task scopes T4 to NB1 and the 8 CDMO stations.

post_hoc_rule: Anything decided after seeing coverage is labelled post-hoc in NOTES.md and RL.
